fig1_class_distribution: Number of usable clips per class (535 clips, 26 classes) after quality filtering and landmark extraction, split into training (454) and validation (81) clips (random split). Classes are sorted by total count; the dashed line is the mean clips per class. Min = 12 (25-Taamrachuda), max = 30 (1-Ardhpatka).
fig2_tcn_training: Training history of the TCN (left: cross-entropy loss; right: accuracy). Blue = training set, orange = validation set. The red star marks the checkpoint kept for evaluation (epoch 35, validation accuracy 93.83%); the dotted vertical line marks the last epoch run (epoch 50), at which early stopping (patience 15 epochs on validation accuracy) ended training. Axis ranges are identical for all models.
fig5a_f1_tcn: Per-class F1 score of the TCN on the validation partition (n = 81 clips, random split), sorted in ascending order. The dashed red line is the macro-averaged F1 (0.929), i.e. the unweighted mean over the 26 classes.
fig6a_confusion_tcn: Confusion matrix of the TCN on the validation partition (n = 81 clips, random split). Rows are true classes, columns predicted classes; non-zero cells show the clip count. Axis numbers refer to the class legend on the right; 5 clip(s) are misclassified (off-diagonal cells).
fig8_ablation_tcn: Validation accuracy (mean +- standard deviation over 5 random seeds, same random split) of the proposed TCN and three simpler baselines: a TCN without velocity channels, an MLP on temporally pooled features and an MLP on a single middle frame.
fig3_bilstm_training: Training history of the BiLSTM (left: cross-entropy loss; right: accuracy). Blue = training set, orange = validation set. The red star marks the checkpoint kept for evaluation (epoch 77, validation accuracy 81.48%); the dotted vertical line marks the last epoch run (epoch 92), at which early stopping (patience 15 epochs on validation accuracy) ended training. Axis ranges are identical for all models.
fig5b_f1_bilstm: Per-class F1 score of the BiLSTM on the validation partition (n = 81 clips, random split), sorted in ascending order. The dashed red line is the macro-averaged F1 (0.808), i.e. the unweighted mean over the 26 classes.
fig6b_confusion_bilstm: Confusion matrix of the BiLSTM on the validation partition (n = 81 clips, random split). Rows are true classes, columns predicted classes; non-zero cells show the clip count. Axis numbers refer to the class legend on the right; 15 clip(s) are misclassified (off-diagonal cells).
fig4_training_comparison: Learning trajectories of the TCN (green) and BiLSTM (red) on the validation partition: accuracy (left) and cross-entropy loss (right). Red stars mark each model's selected checkpoint; dotted vertical lines in the model's colour mark the last epoch before early stopping. Axis ranges match Figures 2 and 3.
fig5c_f1_comparison: Per-class F1 score of the TCN (green) and the BiLSTM (red) on the same validation partition, sorted by the TCN's F1 score.
fig7_latency: Forward-pass latency per batch of 32 clips (172 x 236 input), mean +- standard deviation over 100 timed runs after 20 warm-up runs, on NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 Laptop GPU (FP32 (no autocast), CUDA-synchronised timing). Pose estimation and preprocessing time are not included.
